title: federation-server: multi-mailbox peer domains
description:
BREAKING (0.5), deferred by Mark 2026-10-30; follows jmap-chat-spec bead jmap-chat-spec-f82v (a peer domain hosts one or more mailboxes). Do not start until the draft text lands.

Changes in crate-jmap-chat-federation-server (and -types, peer-auth if needed):
- Caller-identity check: deliver.rs ~line 254 rejects unless claimed == AuthenticatedPeer::peer_identity. Change to host binding: bind_identity(claimed, peer_domain), with DID verification for host-less identities. AuthenticatedPeer::peer_identity becomes optional / per-mailbox.
- Recipient addressing: Peer/* argument types gain the recipient identity (field name per the draft) and stop relying on a receiver-local accountId; handlers resolve the recipient mailbox through a backend hook (identity -> local mailbox).
- jmap-peer-auth-io: discovery/key fetch must not require ownerUserId in the unsigned Session.
- Sending helpers (SenderIdentities, peer_group_update_args) emit the new fields.
Downstream: chinwag (bead chinwag-nuqe.7.17) and kith.
